basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 31-year-old gaming enthusiast from Richmond, Virginia. I work as a graphic designer for a small agency and love to unwind after work by diving into the world of video games. I'm pretty laid-back and prefer cooperative, non-competitive games. When I'm not gaming, you might find me exploring new music, trying out new recipes, or hanging out with my two cats. I'm single and enjoy making new friends online. I usually hop online in the evenings, around 7 PM to midnight, Eastern Time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been gaming since I was a kid, starting with the Super Nintendo. My interest in gaming expanded as I got older, and I taught myself a lot about game mechanics and storytelling through playing different genres. My graphic design background also gives me an appreciation for the visual aspects of games.
